evidence.decision: Assigns communicated purpose, chooses standard versus custom response and defines brief coherent interruptible motion with redundant state information.
evidence.artifact: Delivers motion/state artifact or implementation with explicit interruption and reduced-motion behavior.
evidence.transformation: Spatial dashboard stops rotating the room/flying cards for a filter change and retains stable environment, selected filter and updated result count.
evidence.verification: Tests rapid input/stale queues, blocked tasks and lost reduced-motion feedback; timing/performance claims need measurement.
evidence.applicability: Preserves device-appropriate game tradeoffs, stable spatial references and Watch easing limitations; Linux cannot establish physical comfort.
evidence.handoffs: Routes accommodations to Accessibility, symbol feedback to SF Symbols and spatial reference geometry to Spatial layout.
evidence.distinctiveness: Animation interruption, reversible state relationships and world-motion risk determine actual interaction behavior.
